profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Solis Health Plans
profile.summary:
Software developer with 10 years of professional experience in design, development, debugging, deployment of Client–Server software and Web based Applications. 
Designed, architected, programmed WinForms and Libraries.
Extensive Knowledge in Visual Studio.NET.
Experienced in WinForms application development using VC#, ADO.NET.

Qualifications:
• Programming Languages: C#, Transact-SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
• Databases: MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MS Access, MySQL.
• Frameworks and Technologies: Web Forms, Windows Forms, ASP.NET MVC, AJAX, LINQ, Entity Framework, ADO.NET, CSLA, Telerik Controls, Telerik Report, Telerik Kendo UI, jQuery UI.
• Version Control & Project Tracking: Team Foundation Server. 
• Platforms: Microsoft .NET Framework (3.5, 4.0, 4.5)
• Tools: Visual Studio 2008, 2010, 2012, 2013, SQL Server Management Studio.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Performing all the duties of an Integration Developer.
Develop Web Client using Angular.
Web API development using ASP.Core and any other MS related technologies.
XML Schemas and JSON architecture design and development to guarantee best architectural design practices and quality.
JSON and XML serialization/deserialization and mapping to DB entities and OOP objects.
Design and development to build and maintain various application layers using design patterns and best approach and practices.
Own and participate in environment builds, developments, troubleshot, etc.
Apply and follow Agile (Scrum) and Waterfall approaches in order to guarantee time efficiency and avoid issues.
Quality software that satisfies requirements and Definition of Done.
Team collaboration and take the lead in different initiatives to ensure product delivery on time and high quality.
Collaborate with other Developers, Testers, Scrum master, PM, PO, BSA/TSAs in testing, design, development.
Collaborate in bug fixes related to code written by him or any other team member.
Entity Framework Development.
SSIS, TSQL and Stored Procedures
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · jQuery · ASP.NET Core · SQL Server Management Studio · .NET APIs · JavaScript · Angular CLI

positions.title: Application Software Developer
positions.description:
http://alluresoftwaresolutions.com

• Designed, developed, maintained and tested the Practice Manager software (https://www.alluremedsystems.com) for billing companies, using ASP.NET, MVC, JQuery, Telerik Report, Telerik Kendo UI HTML Framework, C#, Entity Framework, SQL Server, CSS3, HTML5. 
• Developed an internal solution to manage patient's, insurances and medical providers.
• Developed an internal solutions to generate and process Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) files such as 837P, 837I, 999, 277, 835.
• Developed a method to send and receive EDI files via FTP, SFTP or FTPS between billing company and clearing house.
• Designed, developed, maintained and tested others applications such as Snapshot MD (http://dashboard.alluremedsystems.com/) software to provider customers of billing companies (medical providers) information about their claims status in real time, financial projections and reports of their billings, Electronical Medical Record (EMR - http://allureemr.com/).

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed a web solution to manage padel field reservations, customer’s data, inventory, field status, schedules, payments and human resources.
• Participated in the design and development of Web Form using Master Pages, Server controls, Cascading Style sheet, JavaScript, HTML.
• Experienced using SQL Server with ASP.NET, C#, AJAX, CSLA, LINQ.
• Effectively used dataset, data reader, data view to read data using ADO.Net objects.
• Effectively used gridview to display data in a well-defined manner with sorting, paging, Export to Excel, Export to Zip features.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Effectively used Windows Forms for the development a big desktop applications for internal use.
• Designed, maintained and administrated database in Oracle 10g.
• Wrote PL-SQL queries for creating views and stored procedures in Oracle. Used joins, unions to get data from different tables and databases.
• Managed and administrated users, roles and permissions in Oracle Database.
